newsitem.title: NORWAY: FORECAST - Norway's May CPI seen up 2.47 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Norway's May CPI seen up 2.47 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Norway's consumer prices (CPI) are expected to rise in May by an average 2.47 percent compared with May 1996 and to increase by 0.1 percent from April, according to a Reuter poll of 10 Norwegian and international analysts.
Year-on-year estimates for inflation ranged between 2.4 percent and 2.6 percent, while estimates for the month-on-month figure were between 0.0 percent and plus 0.15 percent.
For the year, analysts forecast inflation at 2.49 percent compared with projections of 2.54 percent in an April survey.
Norway's CPI is due to be released on June 10 at 0745 GMT.
Participants in the survey were Bergen Fonds, Christiania Bank og Kreditkasse, Den norske Bank, Elcon Securities, Fondspartner, Fokus Bank, I.D.E.A., Orkla Finans, Sparebanken NOR and Unibank.
